gloss: to repel; to bounce back; to throw back

definitions.gloss: to repel; to bounce back; to deflect
definitions.explanation: For a surface to send an object, light, or water back the way it came, rather than letting it through.

definitions.gloss: to fight off; to withstand; to refuse flatly
definitions.explanation: To hold out against pressure, criticism, or hardship and turn it away, or to reject a demand outright.

examples.japanese: ボールを{跳|は}ね{返|かえ}す。
この{生地|きじ}は{水|みず}を{跳|は}ね{返|かえ}す。
{雪|ゆき}が{日|ひ}の{光|ひかり}を{跳|は}ね{返|かえ}して、まぶしいくらいだった。
examples.english: The snow reflected the sunlight so brightly it was almost dazzling.

examples.japanese: {要求|ようきゅう}を{跳|は}ね{返|かえ}した。
{周|まわ}りの{批判|ひはん}を{跳|は}ね{返|かえ}して{優勝|ゆうしょう}した。
examples.english: They fought off the criticism around them and won the championship.

examples.japanese: {原材料|げんざいりょう}{費|ひ}の{上昇|じょうしょう}を{跳|は}ね{返|かえ}すだけの{体力|たいりょく}が、この{会社|かいしゃ}にはまだある。
examples.english: This company still has the strength to withstand the rise in raw-material costs.

notes:
TRANSITIVITY:
- Transitive. What is being turned away takes を.
- The intransitive partner {跳|は}ね{返|かえ}る means to bounce back or to backfire of its own accord.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {水|みず}を{跳|は}ね{返|かえ}す: to repel water
- {光|ひかり}を{跳|は}ね{返|かえ}す: to reflect light
- {批判|ひはん}を{跳|は}ね{返|かえ}す: to fight off criticism
- プレッシャーを{跳|は}ね{返|かえ}す: to shrug off pressure

Sense 2 is the one you meet most in sports reporting and business writing, where someone {跳|は}ね{返|かえ}す adversity by performing well anyway. The compound is {跳|は}ねる (to spring) + {返|かえ}す (to send back).
